Name: Baldur's Valley - BG3 Replacement Mod
Author: WhisperWillow
Description:
[center]This mod replaces Elliott with Astarion from BG3, this is not just a cosmetic change as I've also written/rewritten and added dialougue for all of Elliott's old lines
as well as changed the gift list to fit Astarion.
I've done a play through to test things and fix some spelling errors I know I've made, but I am still not the best with grammer and may have still missed something!
Astarion's schedule is still the same as Elliotts as well as for what triggers heart events is still the same.

[b][u]Updated for 1.6!

[/u][/b]Karlach has now been added replacing Leah, dialougue has been editted/changed as well as events have been slightly editted (nothing too major changed mostly the same just changed to dialougue to fit Karlach a bit more) Gift taste changed to fit Karlach as well.
Astarion's cabin has been given a new updated look inside and out!  As well as has a few easter eggs in his cabin!
Astarion's schedule has been slightly changed! Will be listed below as a spoiler in case you don't want to know!
Fixed things in Astarion's cabin labeled as Elliotts still,
Fixed secret note to refer to Astarion instead of Elliott

[b][u][s]Astarion's Schedule

[/s][/u][/b]this schdeule change was removed for now as it was causing issues and im not 100% sure on how to fix issues it was causing

Unspoiler verison of giftlist
[i]
"Astarion is relatively new in Pelican Town only moving here a year prior to your own arrival, he came here as a form of escape to heal from [/i][i]old wounds, and carve out a new life for himself. This man holds a deadly secrete however for he is a creature of the night, a vampire!
[/i][i]Astarion has a peculiar taste for the finer things in life, his tastes are more expensive then he can usually afford, so any expensive gifts
[/i][i]maybe highly apperciated. However keep in mind his vampiric nature as he despises being gifted things he cannot consume."

"Karlach has moved into Pelican town from a grand city, but that kind of life just wasn't for her. Now she's hear pursuing an art career and living off the land. She tends to like eating things most others wouldn't consider as her tastes vary! She's easily exictable and generally holds a postive outlook on life and living in the valley!"
[/i]

Also also Astarion does curse somewhat which I know is a different since most stardew villagers don't please keep that in mind! [/center]
